findings.evidence: `Hom.lean:47-52` defines `toGrp` and induces the category from it; `Basic.lean:124` proves `instance isCommMonObj (A : AbelianVariety K) : IsCommMonObj A.toOver`; Mathlib has the natural target `CommGrp` at `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/CommGrp_.lean:18-24` with its own category at `:49-50`.
findings.fix: Define `toCommGrp (A) : CommGrp (Over (Spec (.of K))) := ⟨A.toOver⟩`, induce the category from `toCommGrp`, and derive any `Grp`-level API through `CommGrp.forget₂Grp` or a separate `toGrp` abbreviation.
findings.issue: `Category (AbelianVariety K)` is induced via `toGrp`, losing the commutative group-object level that every abelian variety already has.

summary: The hom category is placed one Mathlib level too low: abelian varieties already have a commutative group-object instance, so the induced category should be through `CommGrp`, not plain `Grp`.
